app_description: Izifundo zamarobhothi ne-STEM zamahhala zabafundi, othisha nabazali. Akha amarobhothi ngekhadibhodi, bese ufunda ukuwahlela ngekhodi.
home_intro: Akha irobhothi langempela ngekhadibhodi, izinti nenjini eyodwa encane. Bese ufunda ukulilawula ngekhodi.
home_point_offline: Isebenza ocingweni olulula, ngisho ungenayo i-inthanethi
about_mission: I-Robots For All yenza imfundo yamarobhothi ne-STEM ibe mahhala kuyo yonke ingane nomuntu omdala, noma ngabe uhola malini, ukhuluma luphi ulimi noma ufunda kusiphi isikole.
about_how_build: Akha: yenza amarobhothi anyakazayo ngekhadibhodi usebenzisa ama-crank, amagiya, izinsimbi zokuphakamisa nezixhumanisi, kuxhunywe nohlelo lwezifundo lwesikole.
about_how_control: Lawula: engeza i-micro:bit noma ibhodi elifanayo ukuze irobhothi lakho lihambe, lime futhi likhanyise.
about_how_integrate: Hlanganisa: klama amaphrojekthi aphelele amarobhothi ahlanganisa konke osukufundile.
about_who_body: Abafundi kusukela eBangeni 3 kuya phezulu, othisha, abaqeqeshi bamarobhothi, abazali, imindeni efundisela ekhaya, izikole nezikhungo zomphakathi.
privacy_intro: I-Robots For All isetshenziswa yizingane, ngakho siqoqa okuncane ngangokunokwenzeka. Nakhu ngqo okwenzekayo uma usebenzisa le sayithi.
privacy_collect_none: Lutho ngawe. Awekho ama-akhawunti, awekho amafomu okubhalisa futhi awekho ama-cookie.
privacy_collect_no_tracking: Azikho izikhangiso, akukho ukulandelelwa futhi akukho ukuhlaziywa. Asilayishi lutho kwamanye amawebhusayithi.
privacy_collect_hosting: Umhlinzeki wethu wokusingatha (Cloudflare) uletha amakhasi futhi angagcina amarekhodi ayisisekelo obuchwepheshe, njengamakheli e-IP, isikhashana ukuze kuvikeleke isayithi. Asiwasebenzisi lawa marekhodi ukuhlonza muntu.
privacy_device_body: Ukuze isebenze ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, le sayithi igcina amakhasi ayo, nezifundo ozilandayo, endaweni yokugcina yesiphequluli ocingweni lwakho. Lokhu akuphumi neze ocingweni lwakho.
privacy_device_remove: Ukukususa, sula idatha yale sayithi kuzilungiselelo zesiphequluli sakho.
privacy_children_body: Izingane zingasebenzisa zonke izifundo zinganikezanga lutho lomuntu siqu. Uma singeza ama-akhawunti kamuva, umzali, umnakekeli noma uthisha uzowasetha, futhi sizobuyekeza leli khasi kuqala.
privacy_changes_body: Uma kukhona okushintshayo lapha, sizobuyekeza leli khasi ngaphambi kokuba ushintsho lwenzeke.
lessons_intro: Izifundo zamarobhothi ozenza ngezandla usebenzisa izinto ezishibhile nezisetshenziswe kabusha. Isifundo ngasinye silandela izinyathelo ezinhlanu: Bikezela, Qalisa, Phenya, Shintsha futhi Wenze. Izifundo ze-Junior, zamaBanga R kuya ku-2, zinezine: Bikezela, Qalisa, Zama futhi Wenze.
lesson_adult_help: Umuntu omdala kumele asize kwezinye izinyathelo.
template_print_hint: Phrinta ku-A4 ngo-100% ("Actual size"), hhayi "Fit to page". Bese uhlola ukuthi isikwele esiphepheni silinganisa u-50 mm. Awunayo iphrinta? Sebenzisa izilinganiso ezingezansi ukudweba izingxenye ngerula.
template_check_square: Phrinta ngo-100% (Actual size). Lesi sikwele kumele silinganise u-50 mm; uma kungenjalo, shintsha izilungiselelo zakho zokuphrinta.
template_key: Sika emigqeni eqinile. Goqa emigqeni enamachashazi. Bhoboza izimbobo lapho ubona khona isiphambano.
slides_hint: Swayipha noma usebenzise okhiye bemicibisholo ukuhamba phakathi kwamasilayidi.
footer_promise: Azikho izikhangiso. Akukho ukulandelelwa. Mahhala kuwo wonke umuntu.
footer_licence: Ikhodi: ilayisensi ye-MIT. Izifundo: CC BY-SA 4.0.
notfound_body: Asikwazanga ukulithola lelo khasi. Kungenzeka ukuthi lithuthiwe.
lesson_save_failed: Asikwazanga ukugcina lesi sifundo. Hlola ukuxhumana kwakho bese uzama futhi.
lesson_download_hint: Igcina lesi sifundo kulolu cingo ukuze ukwazi ukusisebenzisa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
offline_body: Leli khasi alikagcinwa kulolu cingo. Amakhasi owavule ngaphambilini asasebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
update_available: Inguqulo entsha ye-Robots For All isilungile.
code_intro: Hlanganisa amabhulokhi ukuze wenze uhlelo. Luzame esikrinini, bese ulithumela ku-micro:bit.
code_failed: Lokho akusebenzanga. Hlola ukuthi i-micro:bit ixhunyiwe bese uzama futhi, noma usebenzise u-Landa i-.hex.
code_no_usb: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukuthumela ngqo ku-micro:bit. Sebenzisa u-Landa i-.hex, bese ukopisha ifayela uliyise ku-drive ethi MICROBIT.
block_forever_tip: Isebenza kaningi kaningi, inqobo nje uma i-micro:bit ivuliwe.
block_random: khetha noma iyiphi kusukela ku-%1 kuya ku-%2
block_motor_tip: Ishayela injini yerobhothi: erobhothini elinenjini eyodwa ishayela kokubili amasondo, erobhothini elinezinjini ezimbili ishayela ekwesobunxele.
code_variable_invalid: Sebenzisa izinhlamvu, izinombolo nezikhala kuphela (kuze kufike ku-30).
code_saved_here: Izinhlelo zigcinwa kule divayisi kuphela. Noma ubani osebenzisa lesi siphequluli angazibona.
code_import_failed: Lelo fayela akulona uhlelo lwe-Robots For All.
code_python_intro: Le yi-MicroPython eyenziwa amabhulokhi akho. Yiyo esebenza ku-micro:bit.
code_edit_python_confirm: Shintshela lolu hlelo ekuthayipheni i-Python? Ungaqhubeka ulushintsha njenge-Python, kodwa izinguquko ngeke ziphinde zibe amabhulokhi.
code_back_to_blocks_confirm: Sebenzisa amabhulokhi akho futhi? I-micro:bit esesikrinini no-Landa bazosebenzisa amabhulokhi. I-Python oyithayiphile igcinwa njengohlelo oluhlukile ku-Izinhlelo zami.
code_python_mode_note: Lolu hlelo lusebenzisa i-Python ethayiphiwe. Thepha u-Amabhulokhi ukuze usebenzise amabhulokhi akho futhi.
code_python_keys: U-Tab ungeza ukuhlehlisa. Ukuphuma ebhokisini lekhodi ngekhibhodi, cindezela u-Esc, bese u-Tab.
block_random_bool: khetha noma yikuphi, iqiniso noma amanga
needs_new_microbit: Idinga i-micro:bit V2, entsha enesipikha nemakrofoni.
code_downloaded: ✓ Kulandiwe. Manje kopisha ifayela uliyise ku-drive ethi MICROBIT.
block_animate: bonisa opopayi %1 %2 njalo emva kwama-ms angu-%3
code_clear_python_confirm: Sula yonke i-Python ethayiphiwe bese uqala phansi?
code_python_copy_name: I-Python yakho ethayiphiwe izogcinwa njengohlelo lwayo. Kufanele ibizwe ngokuthini?
code_name_taken: Usunalo kakade uhlelo olunalelo gama. Sicela ukhethe elinye igama.
lesson_code_no_hardware: Udinga kuphela i-micro:bit esesikrinini esihlelini sekhodi.
lesson_code_microbit: Zama kuqala ku-micro:bit esesikrinini, bese ulithumela ku-micro:bit yangempela uma unayo.
lesson_code_microbit_motor: Zama kuqala ku-micro:bit esesikrinini. Ukuze irobhothi langempela lihambe udinga i-micro:bit, ibhodi lokushayela injini nephakethe lamabhethri lenjini.
sim_sound_tested: Kufanele uzwe ukukhala okufushane. Uma kungenjalo, khulisa ivolumu bese uhlola ukuthi le thebhu ayithulisiwe.
sim_sound_off: Umsindo ucishiwe. Thepha u-Hlola umsindo ukuze uwuvule.
lesson_junior_missions_about: Vula umsebenzi efonini, kuthebhulethi noma kuphrojektha, noma uphrinte ishidi lawo lezithombe. Izingane zifaka umbala ebusweni nasezinkanyezini esikhundleni sokubhala.
sheet_members: Amalungu eqembu (amagama okuqala noma amagama okudlala)
sheet_make_box: Esikwenzile, ukuthi sikuhlole kanjani, nento eyodwa esiyithuthukisile:
sheet_keep: Gcina leli shidi: uthisha wakho ulisebenzisa ukubhala inqubekela phambili yakho.
block_drive_tip: Ishayela injini yesobunxele noma yesokudla, isivinini kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-100. Ibhodi lerobhothi lakho lenza ukuxhumanisa kwezintambo (Irobhothi lami).
code_extension_motordriver: Irobhothi: izinjini ezimbili ezinesivinini, izindebe, izinzwa zomugqa nepeni
world_open_floor_challenge: Ukushayela ngokukhululeka. Zama ukushayela isikwele bese ubuyela lapho uqale khona.
world_dark_tunnel_challenge: Shayela ungene emhubheni omnyama bese ume ngaphakathi kwawo.
world_box_and_back_challenge: Shayela uye phambili ungene ebhokisini, yima, bese uhlehlela emuva ekhaya ume lapho.
world_follow_the_line_challenge: Landela umugqa omnyama kuze kube sekupheleni.
world_simple_maze_challenge: Thola indlela yokuphuma. Uma ushayisa udonga, hlehla bese ujika.
world_grid_delivery_challenge: Hambisa imbewu engadini e-B3 ungashayeli udabule echibini, bese ubuyela epulazini.
world_line_junction_challenge: Landela umugqa, yima ngaphakathi emhubheni, bese uthatha igatsha eliya esibayeni.
world_bump_maze_challenge: Phunyuka emzileni oxakile. Othinta izindonga kancane uyawina.
world_line_maze_challenge: Landela imigqa uze ufike ekugcineni. Isikhathi esishesha kakhulu siyawina.
world_rhino_patrol_challenge: Ukuqapha Obhejane: qapha ucingo, dlula ehlathini elimnyama, hlola umthombo, vula isango bese ubuyela esiteshini sabaqaphi.
world_rhino_patrol_junior_challenge: Ukuqapha Obhejane Abancane: shayela udlule ehlathini elimnyama, yima emthonjeni, vakashela indawo yokubheka bese ubuyela esiteshini sabaqaphi.
world_rhino_patrol_senior_challenge: Ukuqapha Obhejane Abadala: qapha ucingo udlule ezigxotsheni ezintathu ngokulandelana, dlula ehlathini elimnyama, vula isango, hlola umthombo ongemuva kwezindonga zawo bese ubuyela esiteshini sabaqaphi.
mission_rhino_patrol_patrol: Qapha ucingo: isigxobo sasenyakatho, bese kuba esasempumalanga
mission_rhino_patrol_senior_patrol: Qapha ucingo: isigxobo sasempumalanga, esasenyakatho, bese kuba esasentshonalanga
robot_basic_two_motor_name: Imojuli eyisisekelo yezinjini ezimbili (L9110S) enezikhonkwane zengwenya
block_whisker_tip: Kuyiqiniso uma lezi zindebe zithinta okuthile.
block_line_tip: Kuyiqiniso uma le nzwa yomugqa iphezu komugqa omnyama.
block_pen_tip: Yehlisa ipeni ukuze kudwetshwe, noma uliphakamise.
season_rhino_patrol_about: Vikela obhejane: qapha ucingo, hlola umthombo bese ubuyela esiteshini sabaqaphi. Umzila owodwa weqembu ngalinye lamabanga.
world_grid_map_challenge: Shayela kusukela ku-A1 uye esikweleni C4 bese ume lapho. Hlela ukunyakaza kwakho kugridi kuqala: isikwele ngasinye singu-200 mm.
world_art_floor_challenge: Yehlisa ipeni bese udweba isikwele, unxantathu noma uhlamvu lokuqala lwegama lakho.
sim_print_actual_size: Phrinta ngo-100 % (usayizi wangempela), hhayi "fit to page".
sim_print_calibration: Lesi sikwele kumele silinganise u-100 mm ohlangothini ngalunye.
sim_print_build_sheet: Ishidi lokwakha: izingcezu zekhadibhodi nalapho ziya khona
sim_print_no_printer: Awunayo iphrinta? Dweba igridi phansi ngoshoki noma ngetheyiphu: izikwele ezingu-200 mm.
lesson_withdrawn_notice: Kuhoxisiwe: lesi sifundo asikho kusayithi ebukhoma okwamanje.
lesson_in_english_notice: Lesi sifundo asikahunyushwa, ngakho siboniswa ngesiNgisi.
lesson_translation_stale_notice: Isifundo sesiNgisi sishintshile kusukela kwahunyushwa lokhu. Kudinga ukuhlolwa futhi.

account_intro: Eyothisha, abaqeqeshi nabazali. Abafundi abayidingi i-akhawunti ukuze basebenzise izifundo, amaphethini noma isihleli sekhodi.
account_closed: Ama-akhawunti awakavulwa. Konke okunye kusayithi kusebenza ngaphandle kwayo.
account_display_name: Igama lakho njengoba abanye beribona (isibonelo uNkk Dlamini)
account_error: Lokho akusebenzanga. Hlola okuthayiphile bese uzama futhi.
account_privacy: Sisebenzisa ikheli lakho le-imeyili kuphela ukuze ungene.
account_orgs_none: Awukabi yingxenye yesikole noma yekilabhu. Bhalisa esakho ngezansi, noma ucele umphathi wayo ukuthi akungeze.
account_org_waiting: Kulindwe ukuqinisekiswa: ikilasi elilodwa lokuzama elinabafundi abangafika ku-40 kuze kube yilapho
account_org_registered_ok: Kubhalisiwe. Sizokuhlola ngemininingwane esemthethweni. Ungenza ikilasi elilodwa lokuzama manje.
account_org_emis_needed: Inombolo ye-EMIS yesikole inezinombolo ezi-6 kuya kweziyi-12.
account_org_register_needed: Thayipha inombolo yokubhalisa, noma ususe uphawu ku-“ibhalisiwe”.
account_class_share_text: Bhalisa ingane yakho ekilasini lethu le-Robots For All
account_class_qr: Ikhodi ye-QR yesixhumanisi sokubhalisa, yokuphrinta esaziso
account_class_end_confirm: Qeda leli kilasi? Izixhumanisi nokubhalisa kwalo kuyasuswa. Abafundi bagcina amabheji namarekhodi abo.
enrol_soon: Ukubhalisa kuzovulwa maduze. Uma sekuvuliwe, lesi sixhumanisi sizokuvumela ukuthi ubhalise ingane yakho ekilasini layo futhi ukhethe esikugcinayo ngayo.
account_staff_link_note: Thumela lesi sixhumanisi kozakwenu (nge-WhatsApp noma nge-imeyili). Sisebenza kanye, izinsuku eziyi-7. Bayangena bese bejoyina.
account_staff_share_text: Joyina nathi ku-Robots For All njengomsebenzi wa
account_staff_remove_confirm: Susa lo muntu esikoleni noma ekilabhini yakho? Uzolahlekelwa ukufinyelela emakilasini ayo.
account_staff_joined: Usujoyinile. Isikole noma ikilabhu manje isohlwini lwakho.
enrol_bad_link: Lesi sixhumanisi sokubhalisa asiphelele. Cela uthisha noma umqeqeshi wengane yakho ukuthi asithumele futhi.
enrol_sign_in_first: Okokuqala, ngena ngekheli lakho le-imeyili. Sikuthumelela ikhodi; awudingi iphasiwedi.
enrol_notice_kept: Sigcina kuphela igama lokudlala, ibanga, isithombe abasikhethayo, ulimi lwabo, amarekhodi ezifundo zabo namabheji abo.
enrol_notice_not_kept: Asilokothi sigcine isithombe sengane yakho, inombolo kamazisi, usuku lokuzalwa, ikheli noma inombolo yocingo, futhi akukho lutho ngabo oluthunyelwa kunoma iyiphi i-AI.
enrol_notice_who: Nguwe kuphela, nothisha noma abaqeqeshi bamakilasi owakhethayo, abangabona amarekhodi engane yakho. Akekho ongathumela umlayezo enganeni yakho.
enrol_notice_why: Ukuze ingane yakho ibhale ukufunda kwayo, ithole amabheji nezitifiketi, nothisha wayo abone inqubekela phambili yayo.
enrol_notice_withdraw: Ungashintsha noma uhoxise imvume yakho noma nini ku-akhawunti yakho. Ukuhoxisa kususa amarekhodi engane yakho.
enrol_nickname_hint: Igama lokuqala nohlamvu (isibonelo Thandi R) noma igama elimnandi. Hhayi igama labo eliphelele.
enrol_nickname_length: Igama lokudlala linezinhlamvu ezi-2 kuya kwezingama-20.
enrol_nickname_not_full_name: Lokho kubukeka njengegama eliphelele. Sicela usebenzise igama lokuqala nohlamvu, noma igama elimnandi.
enrol_consent_guardian: Ngingumzali noma umnakekeli osemthethweni wale ngane.
enrol_consent_record: Gcina amarekhodi ezifundo namabheji engane yami, njengoba kuchazwe ngenhla.
enrol_consent_class: Vumela othisha noma abaqeqeshi baleli kilasi ukuthi babone igama lokudlala nenqubekela phambili yengane yami.
enrol_name_later: Izitifiketi zingaba negama lengane yakho. Ungalengeza kamuva ku-akhawunti yakho; ligcinwa libethelwe futhi liphrintwa kuphela ezitifiketini.
enrol_done_next: Ingane yakho ingena esikoleni ngekhodi yekilasi, igama layo lokudlala ne-PIN yesithombe. Ungabona inqubekela phambili yayo futhi ushintshe imvume yakho ku-akhawunti yakho.
children_no_class: Akakho ekilasini okwamanje. Vula isixhumanisi sokubhalisa sekilasi ukuze umengeze.
children_left_class: Kwenziwe. Othisha baleli kilasi abasakwazi ukubona ingane yakho.
children_delete_warning: Lokhu kususa unomphela igama lokudlala lengane yakho, amarekhodi ezifundo namabheji. Akunakuhlehliswa.
children_deleted: Kususiwe. Akukho lutho ngengane yakho olugcinwayo.
children_more: Ukuze ubhalise ingane kwelinye ikilasi, vula isixhumanisi sokubhalisa esivela kuthisha noma kumqeqeshi waleli kilasi.
children_name_about: Igama lokuqala nesibongo sengane yakho, njengoba kufanele liphrintwe. Ligcinwa likhiyiwe (libethelwe) futhi livela kuphela ezitifiketini nasemabhejini ayo, nakothisha bekilasi layo uma becela ukulibona. Asilokothi silibonise kuwe futhi; ungalishintsha noma ulisuse.
children_name_consent: Phrinta leli gama ezitifiketini nasemabhejini engane yami, futhi uvumele othisha bekilasi layo ukuthi balibone.
children_name_saved: Kugciniwe. Igama ligcinwa likhiyiwe futhi lizophrintwa ezitifiketini.
children_name_invalid: Sicela uthayiphe igama kuphela: izinhlamvu, izikhala, ama-hyphen nama-apostrophe.
children_name_removed: Kususiwe. Izitifiketi zizoba nomugqa ongenalutho wegama.
account_names_note: Kubonisa amagama abazali abawanikeze ezitifiketini, imizuzu emi-2. Awalokothi agcinwe kulolu cingo, futhi isikhathi ngasinye siyabhalwa.
account_names_caption: Amagama ezitifiketini (azofihlwa futhi emva kwemizuzu emi-2)
account_names_recent: Ukuze kuphephe, phuma bese ungena futhi ukuze ubone amagama.
account_names_after_verify: Amagama angaboniswa uma isikole noma iklabhu yakho isiqinisekisiwe.
email_enrol_subject: Sicela uqinisekise ukubhaliswa kwengane yakho ku-Robots For All
email_enrol_body:
Sawubona,

{organisation} icele ukubhalisa ingane yakho ekilasini elithi {class} ku-Robots For All, iwebhusayithi yamahhala yokufunda amarobhothi nokuhlela.

Akukho okubhalwayo uze uvume. Ukuze ufunde okugcinwayo, ukhethe igama lokudlala lengane yakho futhi unikeze imvume yakho, vula lesi sixhumanisi phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14:

{link}

Ngena ngaleli kheli le-imeyili uma ucelwa. Uma ungenzi lutho, isicelo nekheli lakho le-imeyili kuyasuswa emva kwezinsuku eziyi-14.

Uma ungasazi lesi sikole noma iklabhu, ungayinaki le imeyili.

Robots For All
account_enrol_title: Bhalisa abafundi ukuze abazali babo baqinisekise
account_enrol_about: Thayipha igama lokuqala nesibongo sengane ngayinye (ezitifiketini), ibanga ne-imeyili yomzali. Umzali ngamunye uthola i-imeyili enesixhumanisi sokuqinisekisa phakathi nezinsuku eziyi-14. Akukho lutho olubhalwayo ngengane uze umzali avume; uma engavumi, isicelo siyasuswa.
account_enrol_failed: Amanye ama-imeyili awakwazanga ukuthunyelwa; labo bafundi basesefomini. Hlola amakheli e-imeyili bese uzama futhi.
account_enrol_email_off: I-imeyili eya kubazali ayikalungiswa, ngakho akukho okuthunyelwe noma okugciniwe. Abazali bangabhalisa ingane yabo ngesixhumanisi sekilasi esikhundleni salokho.
account_enrol_check_rows: Sicela uhlole umfundi ngamunye: igama (izinhlamvu kuphela), ibanga nekheli le-imeyili lomzali.
confirm_bad_link: Lesi sixhumanisi asiphelele. Siphinde usivule ku-imeyili, noma ucele isikole noma iklabhu ukuthi isithumele futhi.
confirm_expired: Lesi sixhumanisi siphelelwe yisikhathi noma sesisetshenzisiwe. Cela isikole noma iklabhu ukuthi ithumele esisha, noma ubhalise ingane yakho ngesixhumanisi sekilasi.
confirm_other_email: Lesi sixhumanisi sathunyelwa kwelinye ikheli le-imeyili. Ngena ngekheli le-imeyili elasetshenziswa yisikole noma iklabhu.
confirm_sign_in_first: Ngena ngekheli le-imeyili lesi sixhumanisi esathunyelwa kulo. Sikuthumelela ikhodi; awudingi iphasiwedi.
confirm_keep_name: Gcina igama elithayishwe yisikole noma iklabhu, ezitifiketini nasemabhejini engane yami (ligcinwa likhiyiwe; othisha bekilasi layo bangalibona). Ungalishintsha noma ulisuse kamuva.
email_enrol_reminder_subject: Isikhumbuzo: sicela uqinisekise ukubhaliswa kwengane yakho ku-Robots For All
email_dormant_subject: I-akhawunti yakho ye-Robots For All izosuswa ngaphandle uma ungena
email_dormant_body:
Sawubona,

learner_code: Ikhodi yekilasi (izinhlamvu ezi-6 ezivela kuthisha wakho)
learner_code_wrong: Leyo khodi yekilasi ayisebenzanga. Hlola izinhlamvu ezi-6 nothisha wakho.
learner_choose: khetha izithombe eziyimfihlo ezi-4 futhi uzikhumbule
learner_choose_first: Okokuqala lapha: khetha izithombe zakho eziyimfihlo ezi-4.
learner_choose_again: Manje thepha izithombe ezi-4 ezifanayo futhi.
learner_choose_mismatch: Lezo bezehlukile. Khetha izithombe zakho ezi-4 futhi.
learner_locked: Uzame kaningi kakhulu. Linda imizuzu emi-5, noma ubuze uthisha wakho.
learner_slow_down: Kunemizamo eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Linda umzuzu bese uzama futhi.
learner_offline: Awuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Ukungena kudinga ukuxhumana okokuqala.
learner_idle_note: Uma kungekho osebenzisa ucingo imizuzu eyi-10, luyakhohlwa ukuthi ungubani. Vele uthephe igama lakho futhi.
record_code_unknown: Asiyazi leyo khodi yeshidi. Yihlole ngokubheka ngezansi eshidini lakho.
record_tick_what_sheet_shows: Khetha lokho okukhonjiswa yishidi lakho lephepha.
record_answer_all: Khetha u-Yebo noma u-Hhayi okwamanje ku-“Ngiyakwazi” ngakunye.
record_saved_here: Kugcinwe kulolu cingo. Kuzothunyelwa uma usuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.
record_sign_in_again: Phinda ungene ukuze amashidi akho agciniwe athunyelwe.
record_unsent_warning: Amanye amashidi akho awakathunyelwa. Uma uzisusa kulolu cingo manje, azohlala lapha uze ungene futhi. Susa noma kunjalo?
signin_reset_done: Kusethwe kabusha. Bazokhetha izithombe ezintsha ngokuzayo:
signin_cards_about: Ikhadi elilodwa umfundi ngamunye: ukulihlola kubangenisa ngaphandle kwezithombe. Noma ubani ophethe ikhadi angangena njengalowo mfundi, ngakho wanikeze emcimbini bese uwahoxisa emva kwalokho. Ukwenza amakhadi amasha kukhansela amadala.
signin_cards_confirm: Wenze amakhadi amasha okungena kuleli kilasi? Noma imaphi amakhadi aphrintwe ngaphambili ayayeka ukusebenza.
signin_cards_ready: Amakhadi alungile. Waphrinte manje: awagcinwa futhi awakwazi ukuboniswa futhi.
learner_card_invalid: Leli khadi lokungena alisasebenzi. Ngena ngekhodi yekilasi lakho, noma ubuze uthisha wakho.
progress_legend: ✓ kwenziwe · ✔ kwenziwe futhi kwahlolwa · ◐ izimpendulo ezithi “Hhayi okwamanje” (zingaki) · … kuqaliwe · thepha uphawu ukuze ulubone
progress_revoke_confirm: Uhoxise leli rekhodi? Ngeke lisabalwa enqubekeleni phambili noma emabhejini. Umfundi angaphinda alibhale ishidi.
badge_first_build_about: Uqede isifundo sonke: zonke izinyathelo zenziwe, konke okuthi “Ngiyakwazi” kunguYebo, futhi kuyasebenza.
badge_i_can_about: Uphendule ngoYebo kukho konke okuthi “Ngiyakwazi” eshidini lesifundo.
badge_cardboard_builder_about: Uqede izifundo ezinhlanu zeSigaba 1: wakha imishini emihlanu esebenzayo.
badge_robot_coder_about: Uqede izifundo ezintathu zeSigaba 2: wenza i-micro:bit ilawule izibani, izinkinobho noma amamotho.
badges_intro: Abafundi bathola amabheji ngokuqeda izifundo nangokubhala amashidi abo ezimpendulo: zonke izinyathelo zenziwe, konke okuthi “Ngiyakwazi” kunguYebo, futhi isakhiwo siyasebenza. “Hhayi okwamanje” kulungile: kukhombisa okufanele kusebenzwe kukho ngokulandelayo, kodwa akubalwa ebhejini.

progress_need_check: Amabheji adinga ukuhlolwa nguthisha noma umqeqeshi (amarekhodi amakwe ukuthi ahloliwe kuphela abalwa emabhejini)
progress_revoke_badge_confirm: Uhoxise leli bheji? Liyasuswa futhi ngeke liphinde linikezwe:
verify_intro: Thayipha ikhodi ephrintwe esitifiketini noma ekhadini lebheji le-Robots For All (ifana no-RFA-ABCD-23), noma uhlole ikhodi yayo ye-QR.
verify_no_names: Ngenxa yobumfihlo, leli khasi alilokothi libonise igama lomfundi.
verify_unknown: Asiyazi leyo khodi. Yihlole esitifiketini: ifana no-RFA-ABCD-23.
verify_error: Asikwazanga ukuhlola manje. Zama futhi uma usuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.
cert_check: Hlola ukuthi lesi sitifiketi siyiqiniso ku-
children_cert_saved: Kugcinwe kokulandiwe kwakho. Kuvule lapho ukuze uphrinte.
progress_print_note: Amagama avela kuphela ku-PDF, lapho abazali bekuvumile; uma kungenjalo kunomugqa ongenalutho wokubhala kuwo. Ifayela aligcinwa ndawo ngaphandle kokulandiwe kwakho.
family_intro: Ufundisa ekhaya? Qala iqembu lomndeni lezingane zakho (kuze kube ngu-8). Zibhala amashidi azo ezimpendulo futhi zithole amabheji nezitifiketi, ezithi “Sinikezwe yi-Robots For All”. Izingane zakho kuphela ezingaba kulo.
family_how: Izingane zakho zingena ocingweni lomndeni ku-Ngena ekilasini lakho, ngale khodi nezithombe zazo eziyimfihlo, noma uthephe u-“Funda njengo-” ngaphansi kwe-Izingane zakho ocingweni lwakho.
family_full: Iqembu lakho lomndeni linezingane ezingu-8, okuyinani eliphezulu.
family_second_about: Yenza isixhumanisi sanye kuphela somunye umzali noma umnakekeli wengane yakho. Uma esivula futhi engena, uyaqinisekisa lapha, bese bekwazi ukubona nokusiza izingane zakho.
family_second_share: Joyina iqembu lethu lomndeni le-Robots For All:
family_guardian_confirmed: Kuqinisekisiwe. Manje bangumzali noma umnakekeli eqenjini lakho lomndeni.
family_guardian_waiting: Siyabonga. Umzali othumele isixhumanisi uzokuqinisekisa, bese ubona izingane lapha.
personal_about: Yenza iphrofayela yakho yomfundi ukuze ubhale amashidi akho ezimpendulo futhi uthole amabheji nezitifiketi. Ingeyakho futhi ayikho eqenjini; izitifiketi zakho zithi “Sinikezwe yi-Robots For All” ngaphandle uma ujoyina nekilasi lesikole noma leklabhu.
personal_consent: Gcina amarekhodi ezifundo zami namabheji ami.
personal_under_age: Ungaphansi kweminyaka eyi-18? Umzali noma umnakekeli angakuqalela iqembu lomndeni.
personal_ready: Iphrofayela yakho yomfundi isilungile. Bhala amashidi akho ezimpendulo futhi ubone amabheji akho ku-Ikhasi lami.
personal_delete_confirm: Ususe unomphela iphrofayela yakho yomfundi, amarekhodi namabheji?
helper_faq_none: Ayikho imibuzo evamile yalesi sifundo okwamanje.
helper_disclaimer: Kubhalwe yi-AI. I-AI ingenza amaphutha: hlola ngaphambi kokwenza.
helper_disclaimer_child: Buza umuntu omdala ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amathuluzi.
helper_offline: Ukubuza kudinga uxhumano. Imibuzo evamile iyasebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
helper_hint_child: Ayikho imininingwane yomuntu siqu eyabelwana ngayo. Ungabhali igama lakho noma lapho uhlala khona. Uma ulibhala, umsizi uyalikhipha ngaphambi kokuthi umbuzo wakho uthunyelwe.
helper_hint_adult: Ayikho imininingwane yomuntu siqu eyabelwana ngayo. Amagama, izinombolo zocingo namakheli owabhalayo ayakhishwa ngaphambi kokuthi umbuzo wakho uthunyelwe, kodwa kungenzeka angakhishwa wonke, ngakho sicela ungawabhali.
helper_one_follow_up: Ukuze ubuze ngokunye okusha, vula leli khasi futhi.
helper_status_children_off: Umsizi awukavulelwa abafundi. Buza uthisha wakho.
helper_status_no_consent: Umzali noma umbheki wakho angakuvulela umsizi ku-akhawunti yakhe. Mbuze.
helper_status_class_off: Uthisha wakho uvalile umsizi ekilasini lakho.
helper_status_class_cap: Ikilasi lakho selibuze yonke imibuzo yanamuhla. Zama imibuzo evamile.
helper_status_daily_cap: Usubuze imibuzo yakho yanamuhla. Izobuya kusasa.
helper_status_paused: Umsizi umisiwe kuwe kuze kube kusasa.
helper_status_month_cap: Umsizi useyiphendule yonke imibuzo yale nyanga. Imibuzo evamile isasebenza.
helper_status_budget: Umsizi uyaphumula kuze kube yinyanga ezayo. Imibuzo evamile isasebenza.
helper_status_refused: Umsizi angasiza kuphela ngokufunda kwe-STEM, ngokuphepha. Zama ukubuza ngenye indlela.
helper_status_blocked: Leyo mpendulo ibingaphephile ukuboniswa. Sebenzisa iphakethe lamabhethri elisohlwini lwezingxenye kuphela, futhi ubuze umuntu omdala ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amathuluzi.
helper_status_safety: Sicela utshele umuntu omdala omethembayo, njengomzali, uthisha noma umqeqeshi. Ungashayela neChildline ku-116. Kumahhala, noma nini.
helper_status_unavailable: Umsizi akakwazi ukuphendula manje. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhashana.
helper_status_no_account: I-akhawunti yakho ayikwazi ukusebenzisa umsizi manje.
helper_status_slow_down: Imibuzo miningi kakhulu ngesikhathi esisodwa. Linda umzuzu bese uzama futhi.
helper_status_offline: Awuxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Imibuzo evamile iyasebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
children_helper_about: ingane yakho ingabhala umbuzo ngesifundo esikuso, njengokuthi "kungani umhlathi werhino lami ungavaleki?", bese ithola impendulo emfushane. Usiza kuphela ngesayensi, ubuchwepheshe, ubunjiniyela nezibalo, futhi ukuphepha kuhlala kuqala. Ingane yakho ingabuza imibuzo efika ku-5 ngosuku, emakhasini ezifundo kuphela. Uthisha wayo angawuvala futhi ekilasini.
children_helper_sent: ayikho imininingwane yomuntu siqu eyabelwana ngayo. Asikaze sithumele igama lengane yakho, igama lokudlala, isikole noma i-akhawunti. Uma wena noma ingane yakho nibhala igama, inombolo yocingo, ikheli le-imeyili noma ikheli lasekhaya embuzweni, umsizi uyalikhipha ngaphambi kokuthi umbuzo uthunyelwe. Kungenzeka angabakhiphi bonke, ngakho sicela ningabhali. Okuthunyelwayo umbuzo, isifundo nezinga lebanga lengane yakho (isibonelo iBanga 3–4). Impendulo ivela kumakhompyutha enkampani ye-AI angaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika.
children_helper_kept: kuphela ukuthi mingaki imibuzo ingane yakho eyibuzile ngosuku, izinsuku ezingu-31. Asiyigcini imibuzo noma izimpendulo, ngakho akekho ongazifunda kamuva.
children_helper_consent: Ngingumzali noma umbheki wale ngane, ngikufundile lokhu, futhi ngivumela ingane yami ukuthi ibuze umsizi we-AI.
progress_helper_about: Kuphela abafundi abazali babo abavule umsizi abangabuza, emakhasini ezifundo. Ubona ukuthi mingaki imibuzo ebuziwe, hhayi ukuthi yini.
children_helper_wrong: yonke impendulo isho kanjalo, futhi itshela ingane yakho ukuthi ibuze umuntu omdala ngaphambi kokusebenzisa amathuluzi, ukusika noma ukushisa.
children_helper_safety: uma ingane yakho ibhala okuthile okuzwakala sengathi ilimele, yesaba noma ayiphephile, umsizi uyitshela ukuthi ikhulume nomuntu omdala eyimethembayo nokuthi iChildline imahhala ku-116. Ngoba akukho okugcinwayo, akekho omunye otshelwayo, ngakho sicela uqhubeke ukhuluma nengane yakho ngokuthi ingaya kubani.
children_helper_charge: ungawuvala umsizi lapha noma nini, futhi uyayeka ngokushesha.
junior_intro: YamaBanga R kuya ku-2: hlela indlela ngamabhulokhi ezithombe, bese ucindezela udlale.
junior_cards_about: Phrinta ku-A4 bese usika ngemigqa enamachashaza. Izingane ziphakamisa amakhadi ukuhlela indlela, bese zithepha izithombe ezifanayo.
